title: Design System: R6SS — Rainbow Six Squad Stats

display.purpose: App title only. Appears once at page top.

headline.purpose: Player name h3 inside section cards.

title.purpose: Run button, section headings, status label, field labels.

label.purpose: Frequency player names, percentages, form labels, search names.

micro.purpose: Kickers (PLAYER), stat titles, match-count metas. Always uppercase + tracked.

motion.name: progress-fill
motion.purpose: Progress bar fill width transition — the only animation in the system.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Names row collapses 5→2col; player sections collapse 2→1col; stat cards collapse 3→1col.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Names row and player sections collapse to 1col; container side padding reduced.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The sole inverted element — light fill on void. Retreats (darkens) on hover rather than brightening.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: #f5f5f5; color: #0b0b0b; border: 1px solid #f5f5f5; border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 15px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "Courier New", monospace; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #222; color: #f5f5f5; border-color: #444; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5f5f5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #222; color: #777; border-color: #444; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Recessed field — darker than the card surface. Double-stroke focus ring (border + 1px shadow).
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="BillyLikesBacon or stats.cc URL...">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #111; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 0; color: #f5f5f5; padding: 9px 10px; font-size: 13px; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "Courier New", monospace; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #666; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #f5f5f5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #f5f5f5; }

components.name: Field Label
components.description: Label with shell-prompt prefix `> ` injected via ::before in muted grey.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #f5f5f5; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "Courier New", monospace; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-field-label::before { content: "> "; color: #888; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flush-to-page bordered container. Background matches page void — cards do not float.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #0b0b0b; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 0; padding: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "Courier New", monospace; }

components.name: Status Label
components.description: Signature component — shell bracket wrapper `[ status ]` via CSS pseudo-elements. Communicates live job state.
components.css: .ds-status { font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: #f5f5f5; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "Courier New", monospace; } .ds-status::before { content: "[ "; color: #888; } .ds-status::after { content: " ]"; color: #888; }

components.name: Win Rate Badge — Positive
components.description: Rectangular semantic chip. Green when win rate ≥ 50%. The only colored element in the system.
components.css: .ds-win-badge { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "Courier New", monospace; border-radius: 0; } .ds-win-positive { color: #6fcf97; border-color: #2d5a3d; background: #0d2018; } .ds-win-negative { color: #eb5757; border-color: #5a2d2d; background: #200d0d; } .ds-win-na { color: #888; border-color: #333; background: transparent; }

components.name: Player Section Card
components.description: Primary results component. Header cap slightly lighter than body; kicker + name hierarchy inside.

components.css: .ds-player-section { background: #111; border: 1px solid #333; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "Courier New", monospace; } .ds-player-section-header { padding: 12px 14px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #333; background: #151515; } .ds-kicker { color: #888; display: block; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-player-name { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #f5f5f5; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-frequency-list { padding: 4px 14px 6px; } .ds-frequency-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 39px; border-bottom: 1px solid #252525; } .ds-freq-player { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #f5f5f5; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-freq-count { color: #888; font-size: 10px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-freq-pct { min-width: 52px; color: #f5f5f5; font-size: 13px; text-align: right; font-weight: 700; } .ds-win-badge { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 0; } .ds-win-negative { color: #eb5757; border-color: #5a2d2d; background: #200d0d; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Per-player scrape progress. Thin 5px track, near-white fill, smooth width transition.
components.css: .ds-progress-wrap { padding: 8px 0; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", "Courier New", monospace; } .ds-progress-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 5px; } .ds-progress-top strong { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #f5f5f5; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-progress-top span { color: #888; font-size: 10px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-progress-track { height: 5px; overflow: hidden; background: #242424; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; background: #f5f5f5; transition: width 0.25s ease; }

components.description: Summary metric tile. 3-up grid in results. Micro uppercase title + large numerical value.

narrative.overview:
R6SS is a tool that reads like a terminal session and thinks like an analyst. Every pixel earns its place by serving a specific stat, label, or action — nothing decorates for decoration's sake. The background is not dark grey, it is near-void (#0b0b0b), and surfaces lift only enough to be distinguished from it. IBM Plex Mono is the sole typeface: its fixed-width rhythm turns every number and username into data, not content.

The punctuation system is the personality: `> ` precedes user-controlled fields, `# ` precedes section headings, and `[ status ]` wraps runtime state. These are borrowed directly from shell idiom, making the interface feel like a tool you invoke, not a page you visit.

Color is rationed deliberately. The primary palette is achromatic — void black, near-white text, and a small range of dark greys for surface layering. Color only appears in the results layer, and only to carry semantic meaning: green for positive win rate, red for negative win rate. Nothing else in the UI is colored.
keyCharacteristics: Single typeface, fixed-width, at high density — everything is data
Near-zero radius everywhere; sharp corners communicate precision
Achromatic except for semantic win/loss indicators in results
Terminal punctuation (`> `, `# `, `[ ]`) as the primary personality system
No shadows, no gradients — depth expressed through surface tone steps only
Status and progress states are first-class UI, not afterthoughts

rules.name: The Achromatic Purity Rule
rules.body: Color is banned from the interface layer. It enters only when a result carries a binary positive/negative verdict (win rate badges). Any UI chrome element using a non-neutral color is a violation.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Win green and loss red always appear together as a system. Never use one without the other being possible in context, and never use either color for non-outcome purposes.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono is the only typeface. No serif fallback before 'Courier New'. No display font stack. Any second font is a violation.

rules.name: The Size Floor Rule
rules.body: 10px is the absolute minimum. No rendered text goes below it. Text at 10px is always uppercase with 0.08em tracking to maintain legibility.

rules.name: The Flatness Rule
rules.body: Cards sit flush against the page background because --panel equals --bg (#0b0b0b). Do not introduce card background values that lift cards off the page surface.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow outside the focus ring (0 0 0 1px var(--text) on focused inputs, which is a focus indicator, not elevation). Adding shadows to cards or buttons is a violation.

rules.name: The Zero-Radius Rule
rules.body: All new components default to border-radius: 0. The feedback modal's rounding is a legacy exception, not a precedent.

rules.name: The Retreating Hover Rule
rules.body: The primary button darkens on hover rather than brightening. This deliberately avoids any 'excitement' signal and keeps the tool register.

dos: Do use border-radius: 0 on every new interactive element, card, input, and container.
Do prefix field labels with `> ` (CSS ::before, muted color) and section headings with `# ` (same treatment).
Do wrap runtime status text in `[ ]` brackets via pseudo-elements.
Do use #111111 for input backgrounds and interactive containers that should feel recessed relative to cards.
Do use the micro style (10px, 600, uppercase, 0.08em tracking) for all kicker/descriptor labels.
Do keep the stat card value at 21px, 600 — it is the largest text on the page and the visual anchor of the results summary.
Do use IBM Plex Mono at all sizes — never swap to a proportional face.
Do match --panel to --bg (#0b0b0b) so cards sit flush rather than floating.
donts: Don't use any color outside the win/loss semantic pair (#6fcf97 / #eb5757) in new UI chrome.
Don't add box-shadow to cards, buttons, or containers — the feedback modal scrim is the only depth effect permitted.
Don't introduce a second typeface, even as an accent or display face.
Don't use border-radius on new components — the feedback modal's 10px radius is a legacy exception, not a pattern to extend.
Don't brighten buttons on hover — the primary button's hover state darkens intentionally.
Don't use color to communicate hierarchy or emphasis — use weight and size steps instead.
Don't go below 10px for any rendered text, and always apply uppercase + 0.08em tracking at that size.
